_comment: Per-subject config for General Math (Class 9-10). Copied from config/_TEMPLATE.json.
subject: math

spelling_corrections._comment: Verified-against-scan OCR/LLM misreads. Applied in Step 8 (and by 05_validate.py) as a token-boundary-aware find/replace on chapter_title AND every topic. NO ENTRY WITHOUT A PAGE CITATION.

merge_overrides._comment: Per-chapter merge rules, applied in Step 9. Chapter key must match the CSV chapter field EXACTLY including the Bengali numeral. '_merge_' folds into the previous kept topic; '_drop_' removes.

scope_split._comment: Step 10 — STANDARD, keep enabled. Trailing '(a, b, ...)' moves to scope_note. max_core_words=5 holds to §3.6 goal.

distinct_pairs._comment: Near-identical strings that are actually opposite concepts. 08_merge.py must never merge a pair listed here.

attribute_nouns_extra._comment: Subject-specific bare attribute nouns invalid as a standalone topic.

lexicon_extra._comment: Valid subject terms a generic Bengali dictionary does not know. Add a word ONLY after confirming its spelling against the page image.
